program_solutions:
(rule!
  ;; Bounding box enclosing the cells
  (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells (find-color g 8)))
         (seed (third (first (filter (lambda (cell)
                                       (and (not (= (third cell) 0))
                                            (not (= (third cell) 8))))
                                     (grid-cells g))))))
    (for*/fold ([out g])
               ([r (in-range (+ (first bb) 1) (third bb))]
                [c (in-range (+ (second bb) 1) (fourth bb))])
      (set-cell out r c seed))))
